asr.full_text: You've heard about Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies. Maybe you're wondering, how do I get started? You could buy Bitcoin and hope the value goes up, or you can do what other smart people have done, mine Bitcoin and pocket the results. But to do that, you need a bank of powerful servers, specialized software, lots of cheap energy to run it, and access to a mining pool. It's a lot to figure out. Learning the ins and outs of Bitcoin and how to set up a mining operation takes time, energy and money. It's not the kind of thing most people can do on their own anymore. That's why we created BitClub Network, to make cryptocurrency mining easy for everyone. Our blockchain experts have created an unprecedented opportunity that allows everyone, including you and me to start mining Bitcoin without having to buy servers, or software, or a power supply Bitclub network takes care of all of that for you here's how it works, when you join Bitcoin network we purchased the equipment and software for you and pay the overhead needed to mine cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin. Founded in 2014, we maintain one of the top ten largest mining operations in the world with servers on five continents in places like Iceland, where power is inexpensive, clean, and renewable. We run our own public mining pool, consistently one of the ten largest in the world, with more than 500 petahash deployed and we're continuously adding more power. So it's no wonder that over the past few years Bit Club Network has mined more than 70,000 Bitcoin. Our size means we've achieved economies of scale, that allow us to reduce costly overhead and pass on the efficiencies to our members. We've built key relationships with hardware providers to ensure our ability to add mining capacity and accommodate the growing interest of miners around the world. At the end of each day, we divide up the proceeds and distribute and get a share in all three. You are in control. What's more, when you introduce a new member to BitClub and they join one or more of the pools that you're a member of, you'll earn even more. The more people you share BitClub with, the greater your earning potential. With BitClub Network, it's easy to start mining Bitcoin, and that means you can spend your time and your growing Bitcoin proceeds on the things that matter most while we do the mining work. Imagine you're working at your desk or grocery shopping for the week, enjoying a family vacation, or spending time with the one you love for a night out. Your BitClub mining pool is hard at work in the background, mining new Bitcoin 24 hours a day. Our support keeps going too. Our Member Support Team is available 24-7 to help you get started and to answer any questions you have about your membership in BitClub Network. It's never been easier to reap the rewards of cryptocurrency mining. To learn more, contact the person who invited you to view this video and get started today.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes joining BitClub Network for passive recurring cryptocurrency-mining proceeds while presenting the service as an easy way to earn without operating mining equipment yourself. It also encourages recruitment by claiming that introducing new members increases earning potential and ends with a direct instruction to contact the inviter and get started.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S04 fits because participation in a BitClub membership or mining pool is linked to shared cryptocurrency-mining proceeds and payout pools. S06 is additionally supported because the video connects earnings to introducing new members and depicts a network structure.
